X99-XD4 Intel LGA 2011-V3 Micro-ATX Server Motherboard in Bangladesh


The X99-XD4 Intel LGA 2011-V3 Server Motherboard is a compact yet powerful Micro-ATX server motherboard designed for enterprise servers and professional workstations. Built with the Intel C612 chipset, it supports Intel Xeon E5-2600 V3/V4 processors, delivering reliable performance, scalability, and 24/7 stability for business-critical workloads.


This motherboard supports DDR4 ECC and non-ECC memory, ensuring data integrity and smooth multitasking in virtualization, database, and cloud environments. Its Micro-ATX form factor makes it an ideal choice for space-efficient rackmount or tower server builds without compromising enterprise features.


The X99-XD4 includes multiple PCIe expansion slots for RAID controllers, high-speed network cards, and GPUs, along with flexible storage connectivity to meet growing server demands. At D CORE, we supply genuine X99-XD4 server motherboards in Bangladesh at competitive prices with expert support.


Key Features


  • Chipset : Intel C612 Chipset
  • Support LGA 2011-3 Intel series processors
  • Intel C612 server chipset
  • DDR4 ECC & non-ECC memory support
  • Multiple PCIe expansion slots
  • Micro-ATX form factor
  • Designed for 24/7 enterprise operation
  • 1 * Gigabit network card, support PXE and network wake-up functions
